pains: I hire guys in the spring, and by July half of them are gone.
I need a crew lead I can trust, so I can stop being on every single roof myself.
After a storm my phone doesn't stop, and I'm up on a roof for all of it.

faqs.q: Can you help us staff up before storm season?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us how many people you'll need and when, and we'll start lining up candidates ahead of time instead of after the rush hits.

faqs.q: Do you hire crew leads, or just laborers?
faqs.a: Both. We hire for every level of a roofing crew, from ground crew to foremen who can run a job without you there.

faqs.q: Can you follow up with homeowners who are waiting on their insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep in touch with homeowners, remind them what's needed from them, and follow up on payments. We don't act as a public adjuster or handle the claim itself.
We focus on the people you hire onto your own team. If you work with sub crews, bring it up on the call and we'll tell you straight what we can help with.

faqs.q: Our busy season and slow season are very different. Does that work?
faqs.a: Yes. We'll talk through your seasons on the first call and plan the work around them.

cta.heading: Get your crew lined up before the next storm.
cta.body: Book a short call. Tell us how many people you need and when, and we'll tell you plainly how we'd find them.
